title: PSX Character Library v1.8: Highcourt added
bodyHtml:
Highcourt is in the Library: 14 people of a royal court, from the king and the queen to the jester, the court mage and the spymaster, 42 skinned entities, rigged on the same skeleton with the same 45 clips as every other pack here. That makes 22 packs and 307 characters on this page.

If you own the Library, download again at no extra cost. Highcourt joins the Dark Ages archive beside Oathfall and Plaguewick (now 645 MB), so that is the only file you need. The other eight archives changed only in their root files (Readme, catalogue and manifest now list 22 packs); the packs inside them are the same bytes as before.

Changelog, v1.8.0:

  • Added Highcourt: 14 PSX Royal Court and Nobles: King, Queen, Prince, Princess, Chancellor, Royal guard, Jester, Court mage, Steward, Lady in waiting, Ambassador, Bishop, Spymaster, Herald.
  • Dark Ages archive: now Oathfall, Plaguewick and Highcourt.
  • Readme, CATALOGUE and manifest updated to 22 packs and 307 characters.

Highcourt is also sold on the Ironvale page, together with Ironvale and Oathfall: https://csaf.itch.io/ironvale-psx-fantasy-adventurers

How we tested it: every file in the nine archives was read back and checked against the build its own page serves (3434 files). One pack from each archive was extracted and run through our pack gate, and a blank Godot 4.7 project imported all 378 of their GLBs with no errors.

The price: this pack is number 22, which reaches the second and last step the page has printed since 13 November. The Library stays $19.99 until 7 December 2026, then it is $24.99 for new buyers (the first step, announced in its own post here). On 8 January 2027 it becomes $29.99 for new buyers, and that is the ceiling: it never rises past it, however many packs join. If you already own it, nothing changes for you.

Free first: one character from every one of these packs is free in the PSX Characters Sampler.

Count so far: 24 live PSX listings, 8 of them sold, 29 purchases in total.

For anything, post a comment on the page. If the Library helps your game, a quick rating is the best way to support the next pack.

Made with AI tools: the bodies were generated by scripts an AI system wrote, and every texture is an AI image model's painting projected onto the mesh. The skeleton and clips are the CC0 Quaternius Universal Animation Library.
